title: Arithmetic lower bound for the actual interpolation minor
statement: For the original fixed admissible data $d$, a positive height $H$, and any selected square minor $A$ with $\det A\ne0$, the normalized logarithmic determinant satisfies $\log\lVert\det A\rVert/(N H)\ge -(1-\mu)-E$. Here $N$ is the actual row count, $\mu$ is the normalized mean row weight, and $E=d.\mathrm{arithmeticError}$. All quantities use the original source definitions.
explanation: The two original denominator/weight interface lemmas reduce this statement to the original generic selected-minor arithmetic lower bound. Only that genuine proved parent theorem is reused.
